brief: A two-storey storage tower for a workbench with at least two drawers.

requirements.evidence: Stacked pieces at level 0 and level 1: piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,0,1;full and piece:0,1,0;half-n + piece:0,1,1;half-n joined vertically with snap:0,0,0;full, snap:0,1,0;half-n and horizontally with jointBolt:0#0,0#5 and jointBolt:1#0,0#5. check_build meshClash clear.
Two cut-face drawers installed: drawer:0#0,1#cut at level 0 and drawer:1#0,1#cut at level 1, offered via half-base cut faces.

Top-level open storage provided by bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-full (full hex) and bin:0,1,1~hex-bin-half-n-full (half-n), giving tray storage above the drawers in a compact ~1.5-hex footprint suitable for workbench side-tower.

finish.summary: Built compact two-storey tower (full + half-n column, 2 levels) with 2 south-facing drawers (one per storey) and 2 top bins for parts storage. Verified with check_build: ok true, meshClash clear, info-only open cap faces.

M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
